items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So Jordan will call him Manga Parade.

ctx.x: He done like his daddy to hold up the whole brass band at one corner.

He was a powerhouse. Yeah. I think he was a powerhouse. That's something. So Jordan will call him Manga Parade. Those powerhouses, man. Yeah, kid I was a powerhouse those days, too. Yeah. He played with this, you know. Yeah. Not sure. Yeah.

What is it? Well, I'll tell you that. Can you tell us any more about your son, and we didn't talk too much about him? That's his girlfriend. How old was he when he started to play? Do you remember? He can't go far with you, but that's her girlfriend.
